test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Hisar is to the north of Bhiwani, Bhiwani is to the west of New Delhi, Rohtak is to the south of Panipat and to the east of New Delhi. What is the position of Hisar with respect to Panipat?
solution:
Diagram is drawn as per the given information:

 
• Hisar is to the north of Bhiwani.
 
• ​Bhiwani is to the west of New Delhi.
 
• ​Rohtak is to the south of Panipat and to the east of New Delhi.
